pretreatment: buffered oxide etch (BOE) solution composed of HF and NH4F and then rinsed in deionized water to remove the native oxide
evidence: Boron-doped Si(100) wafers were used as the substrate for the film deposition. Before being loaded into the hot-wall reactor, the Si wafer was cleaned by a buffered oxide etch (BOE) solution composed of HF and NH4F and then rinsed in deionized water to remove the native oxide.
